questionnaire.title: Financial Services Compliance Role Profile
questionnaire.description: FS Compliance-specific role requirements for conduct risk, financial crime, regulatory compliance, and consumer protection roles in UK regulated firms. Covers SM&CR, AML/Financial Crime, Consumer Duty, Market Abuse, Product Governance, and RegTech. Excludes quantitative risk (separate FS Risk domain).
